title: Governing factored axial load on a column with wind uplift (ASCE 7)

rubric.text: The response should identify 1.2D + 1.6Lr + 0.5W style combinations as not governing compression once wind is uplift, and should identify 0.9D + 1.0W as governing the uplift case.

expert_notes: Combinations: 1.4D = 84; 1.2D + 1.6Lr + 0.5W = 72 + 64 - 55 = 81; 1.2D + 1.6Lr (with 0.5W omitted when it relieves) = 136, which governs compression (taking W = 0 where it reduces the effect); 1.2D + 1.0W + 0.5Lr = 72 - 110 + 20 = -18; 0.9D + 1.0W = 54 - 110 = -56, which governs uplift. Max compression 136 kN, max tension 56 kN.
